module_summary: Bit-serial RISC-V machine-mode CSR unit: holds mstatus/mie/mcause bits in flops, computes write/set/clear CSR values serially, and edge-detects timer interrupts.

anchors.name: mstatus_mie
anchors.why: Global interrupt enable mstatus.MIE; written by CSR access, cleared on trap, restored on mret.

anchors.name: mie_mtie
anchors.why: Timer interrupt enable bit written via mie CSR access; gates timer_irq.

anchors.name: mstatus_mpie
anchors.why: Saves mstatus_mie on trap entry for restore on mret.

anchors.name: mcause3_0
anchors.why: mcause exception code bits, set by trap cause logic or CSR write.

anchors.name: mcause31
anchors.why: mcause interrupt bit, set from o_new_irq on trap or CSR write.

anchors.name: csr_in
anchors.why: New CSR value: external write, set or clear of current csr_out by operand d.

anchors.name: o_q
anchors.why: Serial CSR read value (mstatus, mcause or regfile CSR) returned to rd.

anchors.name: i_csr_source
anchors.why: Selects CSR operation: keep, write, set or clear.

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: CSR write operand: immediate or rs1 chosen by i_csr_d_sel.

anchors.name: o_new_irq
anchors.why: Rising-edge detected timer interrupt request to the core; also sets mcause.

anchors.name: timer_irq_r
anchors.why: Previous timer_irq value for rising-edge detection.

anchors.name: timer_irq
anchors.why: Pending timer interrupt: mtip gated by mstatus_mie and mie_mtie.

anchors.name: i_trap
anchors.why: Trap entry: clears MIE, saves MPIE, updates mcause.

anchors.name: i_mret
anchors.why: mret: restores mstatus_mie from mstatus_mpie.

anchors.name: i_mstatus_en
anchors.why: mstatus CSR access enable: write MIE and drive mstatus onto csr_out.

anchors.name: i_mie_en
anchors.why: mie CSR write enable for mie_mtie.

anchors.name: i_mcause_en
anchors.why: mcause CSR access enable: write and read mcause.

anchors.name: i_rf_csr_out
anchors.why: CSR value stored in the register file, ORed into csr_out.

anchors.name: i_rs1
anchors.why: rs1 serial operand for CSR write/set/clear.

anchors.name: i_csr_imm
anchors.why: Immediate operand for CSRxI instructions.

groups.name: CSR registers
groups.description: mstatus MIE/MPIE, mie MTIE and mcause flops with per-CSR enables.

groups.name: CSR read/modify datapath
groups.description: Builds csr_out from CSR sources and csr_in via write/set/clear.

groups.name: Trap and interrupt control
groups.description: Timer interrupt edge detect and trap/mret driven CSR updates.
